definitions.gloss: initially, at first, at the beginning
definitions.explanation: Refers to the early stage or original point in time when something began. Often implies a contrast with what happened later.

examples.japanese: {当初|とうしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a change from the original plan.

examples.japanese: {当初|とうしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{賛成|さんせい}している→賛成する：05647_sanseisuru⟧。
examples.english: I was against it at first, but now I agree.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{当初|とうしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見積|みつ}もり→見積もり：05153_mitsumori⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: The construction cost significantly more than the initial estimate.

notes:
USAGE:
Can function as a noun modifying other nouns ({当初|とうしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧ = initial plan) or as an adverb ({当初|とうしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ = at first). Slightly formal in register. Almost always implies that what was originally the case has since changed.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {当初|とうしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧: the original schedule
- {当初|とうしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧: the original purpose
- {当初|とうしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧〜だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧: at first it was... but
- {当初|とうしょ}⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧: initial budget
